title: In 1935 the US Army Bombed a Volcano to Stop Its Lava

scenes.text: The US Army once dropped bombs on a river of lava.
In 1935, Mauna Loa erupted, and the lava crept toward the town of Hilo.
It moved about a mile a day, toward the water supply of the town.
So on December twenty-seventh, planes dropped six hundred pound bombs onto the flow.
Six days later, the eruption ended.
Did the bombs work? Nobody knows for sure.

description:
The US Army once dropped bombs on a river of lava.
In December 1935, planes bombed a Mauna Loa lava flow that was creeping toward Hilo. The eruption ended six days later, but many geologists think it was a coincidence.
Do you think the bombs worked?
first_comment: Coincidence or smart engineering? Make your case.
